derivations: EA(Q)=E0(Q)-E-(Q); never E0(Q_neutral)-E-(Q_anion) as a vertical quantity.
E-(Q)-E0(Q0)=[E0(Q)-E0(Q0)]-EA(Q); positive EA on a deformed geometry does not eliminate deformation/access cost.
RN3+e(vacuum)->RN(-)+N2 endpoint energy is element/electron balanced but gives neither a reaction barrier nor a graphene-injection energy.
A first sampled EA>0 on the anion-optimized lineage is not evidence that the neutral initial trajectory reached that geometry or crossed the surfaces.

For finite-fragment CT at matched geometries, DeltaE_CT=IP(graphene fragment)-EA(molecule)+DeltaE_interaction. Under an electron-reservoir approximation the corresponding term is -mu_e-EA; a vacuum-zero attachment threshold cannot be directly compared to hot-electron excess above the Fermi level without the reservoir reference.
code_path_checks: job_succeeded treats any HURRAY OR normal termination as success: one successful scan window can mask a failed later window.
A5 generates charge pairs from each saved scan geometry. Exact input coordinates and current parent snapshots matched here.
A6 selects the first positive TZVP EA point along anion scan; both systems choose point1. It is not a numerically solved energy-surface intersection.

competitive_explanations.hypothesis: Old TMS EA -2.13 was arithmetically wrong
competitive_explanations.reason: Recomputed old raw r2SCAN energies and matched final neutral geometry recover the old value.

competitive_explanations.hypothesis: TMS is always vertically endothermic along the tested coordinate
competitive_explanations.reason: Neutral-lineage sample6 onward has positive hybrid EA; anion-lineage geometries are positive from sample1.

competitive_explanations.hypothesis: Positive anion-lineage EA proves easy injection from the initial neutral configuration
competitive_explanations.reason: At same Nalpha-Nbeta 1.24 Angstrom, other coordinates differ strongly; deformation plus electronic attachment costs remain explicit.

competitive_explanations.hypothesis: PFPA can be substituted for TMS in entry verdict
competitive_explanations.reason: Same-protocol first neutral-lineage EA differs in sign; PFPA is a distinct molecule/control.

competitive_explanations.hypothesis: Finite basis/method and an unbound extra electron undermine a universal quantitative threshold
competitive_explanations.reason: TMS initial vertical EA magnitude changes substantially from r2SCAN to diffuse hybrid and completed DLPNO. No continuum/basis-limit validation performed.

competitive_explanations.hypothesis: TMS neutral point9 negative rebound proves reentrant bound/unbound physics
competitive_explanations.reason: Parent relaxed point not converged; retain only its fixed-geometry SP result, not a certified relaxed trend.

r2_release_effect: LB-ENTRY-COMPETITION is resolved for the exact legacy-EA target and its overbroad transfer. A reconstruction can report TMS entry as unresolved with these retained molecular constraints. It cannot claim either global DEA exclusion or a preferred productive mechanism from this audit.

suggested_state_records.text: Old isolated TMS r2SCAN neutral-geometry vertical EA is -2.126641636558386 eV.
At neutral-lineage Nalpha-Nbeta=1.74 Angstrom, TMS same-geometry EA is +0.1849 eV (TZVP) and +0.290847 eV (TZVPD); this is not an interface pathway claim.
PFPA-Me neutral-lineage first 1.24 Angstrom sample has positive same-geometry EA +0.4048/+0.467426 eV; PFPA is a distinct control, not TMS.

TMS neutral versus anion optimized first samples have the same 1.24 Angstrom scan coordinate but NNN angles 174.751 versus 133.523 degrees. At TZVPD the latter costs 1.72814049 eV neutral deformation; positive EA does not erase this access condition.
Completed isolated TMS DLPNO-CCSD(T)/aug-cc-pVTZ vertical EA at its neutral minimum is -0.39823254578974365 eV; finite-basis method-specific result.
Completed same-method molecular separated endpoint TMSN3+e(vacuum zero)->TMSN(-)+N2 is +0.01760908070508041 eV electronic energy; not DeltaG or a barrier.
Five PFPA higher-level molecular outputs read here are incomplete with no final energies; the completed N2 reference does not complete those pairs.
TMS neutral scan point9 is not certified as a converged relaxed geometry; retain its completed SP values only as fixed-geometry observations.
The old initial molecular negative EA establishes global exclusion of organic/TMS interface DEA.
Whether TMS interface electron attachment leads to productive nitrogen transfer remains unresolved by these isolated-molecule data.
